$description: Design-quality eval prompts for Stark. These are not trigger-only evals; they check whether Stark guidance covers higher-craft design decisions, usability, choreography, typography, libraries, and QA evidence.
$instructions: Each prompt lists expected evidence tags. A run should produce the relevant briefs or decisions before implementation and include QA evidence when the prompt asks for audit or delivery.

prompts.prompt: Design a cinematic landing page for an AI video model. Use a Luma-level quality bar, but transform the reference into an original concept.
